pages.text:
The Jeep Compass has what it takes to gain traction in every corner of
®
your world. Its stunning exterior makes a great first impression, and its
welcoming interior caters to every sense. Trail Rated® performance means
H I G H A P T I T U D E
Jeep Compass will smooth out those everyday bumps and curves, as well as put
you at ease in more challenging terrain. After all, Compass has some inherent
A T A N Y A L T I T U D E
Jeep 4x4 skills: water fording,1* controlled traction, maneuverability, articulation
and ground clearance—just to name a few. Advanced driving assist systems
make for more autonomous and safer handling, while cutting-edge connectivity,
entertainment and information features are delivered through intuitive digital
displays. Clearly, Jeep Compass is built for elevation—in
every sense of the word.
*A note about this brochure: all disclosures can be found on the last page.
